answer: Locks are logged in summit, expire in walnut, and anchor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 146 aliases therefore needs 107 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4563 identities would post 2330 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
